thread:
maria: quick async standup — cut window in 30m, reverify canaries after cut. I pushed the 1.4.2 -> release-candidate branch last night.
ash: saw the push, thanks. I have a cherry for the connection pooling fix, will open in 10. pinging @sophie for review.
sophie: on it, will take a look in 15. if it's small we can merge pre-cut.
nate: heads up, smoke tests in canary failed twice overnight on gpu-queue timeout. CI logs show: `TimeoutError: acquiring device stream` — guessing kernel scheduling. @devops-bot can you confirm node health?
devops-bot: node pool redline on us-west-2-gpu-3 between 03:10-03:40 UTC, restarted driver at 03:42. No persistent disk errors.
ash: thanks. that might explain the flips. my cherry doesn't touch GPUs but may affect conn handling under load.
riya: blocker: the backoff change in #5492 regressed a retry scenario for async batching — hitting client-visible 503s on long tail. I'm reverting locally to validate.
maria: okay if that lines up with the canary fails, we should hold non-critical merges. priority: stable cut.
sophie: review done for ash's PR, left one minor comment about a test flake. if ash addresses, I'm OK merging pre-cut.
ash: pushed a fix for the test, retested locally. link: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/5583
ci-bot: build #5583-ci passed unit, integration pending. queue position 4.
riya: I can't reproduce the 503 locally with the revert; need another run with canary traffic profile.
maria: can we do a limited rollback on the backoff in canary and rerun smoke? ai-sim load @ 5rps for 10m?
ash: I'm fine with the rollback if it speeds cut. I'll prepare the cherry pick but want signoff from @maria before applying.
sophie: +1 for rollback on canary only.
devops-bot: rollback applied to canary-deploy-2026-03-17-12:15 by deploy-runner. Traffic replay scheduled in 2m.
ci-bot: smoke-run: canary-smoke-176789-run1 started.
nate: watching logs now — initial tail shows reduced 503s but still seeing a rare device timeout at t+4m.
riya: ok good — I see reduced client errors. I'm going to hold the full revert until we confirm 15m stability.
maria: agree. choreography: if smoke stays green for 15m, proceed with cherry merges that are validated. if any new regressions, abort and patch.
ash: I'll queue the cherry for the connection-pool fix but won't merge until you confirm, @maria.
sophie: FYI I left a note on the PR about back-compat for older clients.
riya: blocker resolved for now, will continue monitoring.
maria: thanks team. final ask: anyone with open late PRs that need to land in this cut, comment here so we can batch.
ash: one more small perf tweak but non-blocking, will defer to next train. :thumbsup:
sophie: nothing else.
nate: I'll keep an eye on gpu timeouts and open a follow-up incident if they recur.
ci-bot: smoke-run: canary-smoke-176789-run1 finished — status: PASSED (except 1 transient device timeout).
maria: ok closing this thread for now. if smoke holds for 15m I'll announce cut start in #release-ops and notify support. :rocket:
